337: func (c *FmtCommand) formatValueExpr(tokens hclwrite.Tokens) hclwrite.Tokens {
338: 	if len(tokens) < 5 {
339: 		// Can't possibly be a "${ ... }" sequence without at least enough
340: 		// tokens for the delimiters and one token inside them.
341: 		return tokens
342: 	}
343: 	oQuote := tokens[0]
344: 	oBrace := tokens[1]
345: 	cBrace := tokens[len(tokens)-2]
346: 	cQuote := tokens[len(tokens)-1]
347: 	if oQuote.Type != hclsyntax.TokenOQuote || oBrace.Type != hclsyntax.TokenTemplateInterp || cBrace.Type != hclsyntax.TokenTemplateSeqEnd || cQuote.Type != hclsyntax.TokenCQuote {
348: 		// Not an interpolation sequence at all, then.
349: 		return tokens
350: 	}
351: 
352: 	inside := tokens[2 : len(tokens)-2]
353: 
354: 	// We're only interested in sequences that are provable to be single
355: 	// interpolation sequences, which we'll determine by hunting inside
356: 	// the interior tokens for any other interpolation sequences. This is
357: 	// likely to produce false negatives sometimes, but that's better than
358: 	// false positives and we're mainly interested in catching the easy cases
359: 	// here.
360: 	quotes := 0
361: 	for _, token := range inside {
362: 		if token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenOQuote {
363: 			quotes++
364: 			continue
365: 		}
366: 		if token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenCQuote {
367: 			quotes--
368: 			continue
369: 		}
370: 		if quotes > 0 {
371: 			// Interpolation sequences inside nested quotes are okay, because
372: 			// they are part of a nested expression.
373: 			// "${foo("${bar}")}"
374: 			continue
375: 		}
376: 		if token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenTemplateInterp || token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenTemplateSeqEnd {
377: 			// We've found another template delimiter within our interior
378: 			// tokens, which suggests that we've found something like this:
379: 			// "${foo}${bar}"
380: 			// That isn't unwrappable, so we'll leave the whole expression alone.
381: 			return tokens
382: 		}
383: 		if token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenQuotedLit {
384: 			// If there's any literal characters in the outermost
385: 			// quoted sequence then it is not unwrappable.
386: 			return tokens
387: 		}
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	// If we got down here without an early return then this looks like
391: 	// an unwrappable sequence, but we'll trim any leading and trailing
392: 	// newlines that might result in an invalid result if we were to
393: 	// naively trim something like this:
394: 	// "${
395: 	//    foo
396: 	// }"
397: 	trimmed := c.trimNewlines(inside)
398: 
399: 	// Finally, we check if the unwrapped expression is on multiple lines. If
400: 	// so, we ensure that it is surrounded by parenthesis to make sure that it
401: 	// parses correctly after unwrapping. This may be redundant in some cases,
402: 	// but is required for at least multi-line ternary expressions.
403: 	isMultiLine := false
404: 	hasLeadingParen := false
405: 	hasTrailingParen := false
406: 	for i, token := range trimmed {
407: 		switch {
408: 		case i == 0 && token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenOParen:
409: 			hasLeadingParen = true
410: 		case token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenNewline:
411: 			isMultiLine = true
412: 		case i == len(trimmed)-1 && token.Type == hclsyntax.TokenCParen:
413: 			hasTrailingParen = true
414: 		}
415: 	}
416: 	if isMultiLine && !(hasLeadingParen && hasTrailingParen) {
417: 		wrapped := make(hclwrite.Tokens, 0, len(trimmed)+2)
418: 		wrapped = append(wrapped, &hclwrite.Token{
419: 			Type:  hclsyntax.TokenOParen,
420: 			Bytes: []byte("("),
421: 		})
422: 		wrapped = append(wrapped, trimmed...)
423: 		wrapped = append(wrapped, &hclwrite.Token{
424: 			Type:  hclsyntax.TokenCParen,
425: 			Bytes: []byte(")"),
426: 		})
427: 
428: 		return wrapped
429: 	}

435: 	switch len(tokens) {
436: 	case 1:
437: 		kwTok := tokens[0]
438: 		if kwTok.Type != hclsyntax.TokenIdent {
439: 			// Not a single type keyword, then.
440: 			return tokens
441: 		}
442: 
443: 		// Collection types without an explicit element type mean
444: 		// the element type is "any", so we'll normalize that.
445: 		switch string(kwTok.Bytes) {

447: 			return hclwrite.Tokens{
448: 				kwTok,

451: 					Bytes: []byte("("),
452: 				},
453: 				{
454: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenIdent,
455: 					Bytes: []byte("any"),
456: 				},
457: 				{

483: 		// modules that were depending on the auto-stringing.)

488: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenIdent,
489: 					Bytes: []byte("string"),
490: 				},
491: 			}
492: 		case "list":
493: 			return hclwrite.Tokens{
494: 				{
495: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenIdent,
496: 					Bytes: []byte("list"),
497: 				},
498: 				{
499: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenOParen,
500: 					Bytes: []byte("("),
501: 				},
502: 				{
503: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenIdent,
504: 					Bytes: []byte("string"),
505: 				},
506: 				{
507: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenCParen,
508: 					Bytes: []byte(")"),
509: 				},
510: 			}
511: 		case "map":
512: 			return hclwrite.Tokens{
513: 				{
514: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenIdent,
515: 					Bytes: []byte("map"),
516: 				},
517: 				{
518: 					Type:  hclsyntax.TokenOParen,

527: 					Bytes: []byte(")"),
528: 				},
529: 			}
530: 		default:
531: 			// Something else we're not expecting, then.
532: 			return tokens
533: 		}

535: 		return tokens
536: 	}

539: func (c *FmtCommand) trimNewlines(tokens hclwrite.Tokens) hclwrite.Tokens {
